algorithm.Title: Knee Swelling - Female (Adult)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Adult | Female
Definition: UAT-only adult and pediatric non-traumatic knee-swelling pathway screening for septic arthritis, systemic illness, vascular compromise and inability to bear weight before in-person assessment.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for an ambulance for hot swollen knee with systemic illness, severe pain, inability to bear weight, neurovascular change or rapid deterioration; do not self-drive. Do not force walking. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Did this problem begin with a motor vehicle crash or as part of a multi-system crash injury?
questions.Information: A motor vehicle crash or multi-system crash injury belongs in the Motor Vehicle Accident pathway.

questions.Question: Is knee swelling severely painful with inability to bear weight or neurovascular change, or is it hot with marked systemic illness, confusion, breathing change, collapse or rapid deterioration?
questions.Information: NHS.UK joint pain guidance identifies these as reasons for urgent clinical review - a swollen, hot knee can indicate joint infection needing prompt treatment; the local Qatar urgent-care pathway is used here.

questions.Question: With no emergency feature, is there any persistent or unexplained knee swelling, redness/heat, walking limitation, calf symptoms, child concern or higher-risk context?
questions.Information: In-person examination is required to distinguish infection, inflammatory/crystal disease, vascular causes and occult trauma.

advice.Title: Qatar emergency knee-joint response
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 for an ambulance for hot swollen knee with systemic illness, severe pain, inability to bear weight, neurovascular change or rapid deterioration; do not self-drive. Do not force walking. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: fever worsens; unable to bear weight.

advice.Title: In-person knee-swelling assessment
Content: Arrange in-person assessment; telephone review cannot exclude joint infection, inflammatory disease, crystal arthritis, vascular causes or occult trauma. Medication and exact Qatar destination are local approval required.
Call Back If: redness, warmth or fever; unable to bear weight.

references: NHS.UK, "Joint pain", https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/joint-pain/ (page last reviewed 26 February 2026) - applied to knee swelling
